# SatULong 〔BlitzLLVM〕

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Math](BlitzBasic-Math)

</div>


## Command Syntax

```blitzbasic
SatULong:Int32 value:Float32
```

## Description

**〔BlitzLLVM〕** This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

<!-- AUTOGENERATED COPYRIGHT HEADER START -->
Converts a number or a text to a ULong (0 to 18446744073709551615) and stops at 0 and 18446744073709551615 instead of wrapping around. This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the originals have no integers of other sizes. A whole number outside the range becomes the closest number of the range, and a real is rounded to the nearest whole number (halves go to the even one) first. A real that is not a number becomes 0. [ULong](ULong) does the same for a real, but wraps whole numbers around.

**Differences and known gaps:**

* Not in the originals, which have no integers of other sizes.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value` | Float32 | required | A number or a text with a number in it. |

**Returns:** The number, or the closest number of the type if it does not fit.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Print SatULong(-1)
Print SatULong(Long(9000000000))
```

```text
0
9000000000
```
